title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording (audience intro then clean soundboard) captures a scorching first‑time Touch and a rippin' second set.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy, especially the debut of Touch and an incendiary second set that left fans thrilled. Recording quality starts with audience bleed on the opening two tracks but switches to a clear soundboard feed from Dupree's onward, delivering very nice sound for most of the concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight strong musical moments (Touch debut, rippin' set 2) while noting only a minor early‑show audience recording issue.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First two tracks are audience recordings with ambient bleed; from Dupree's onward the feed is full soundboard, resulting in very nice clarity for the majority of the set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual opening with 'Playing' (a rare benefit‑set choice) confused pacing early on, but the concert settled into a powerful flow, highlighted by an explosive second set.
